attributes.title: get_view_json
attributes.description: Reads the saved definition of a Perspective view from the project resources. Use mode='tree' first to get a cheap map of the view's component paths and types, then mode='full' with a component_path to pull the raw view.json for just the subtree you care about. This returns the persisted resource, NOT live runtime values -- for binding detail use get_component_bindings instead. If the view path is wrong, the tool returns the list of real view paths so you can retry. Read-only.

parameters.name: view_path
parameters.description: The Designer view path, e.g. 'Exchange/Report Issue Agent/Line Overview'. No leading slash.

parameters.name: component_path
parameters.description: Optional. Slash-separated chain of component meta.name values starting at root, e.g. 'root/Body/TorqueCard/TorqueValue'. Omit to start at the view root.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'tree' (default) returns a flat list of {path, type, name} for the subtree -- cheap, use this first. 'full' returns the raw view.json for the subtree.
